goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Recover known across-area and within-area percentage shared variance (%sv) and shared dimensionality (d_shared) from the paper simulated two-population datasets, matching Fig. 3e/f. Original pCCA and pCCA-FA fitting comparisons are retained. Supplementary Fig. 4 neural method comparisons are a separately identified source validation route, not pooled into the recovery score.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Recover known across-area and within-area percentage shared variance (%sv) and shared dimensionality (d_shared) from the paper simulated two-population datasets, matching Fig. 3e/f. Original pCCA and pCCA-FA fitting comparisons are retained. Supplementary Fig. 4 neural method comparisons are a separately identified source validation route, not pooled into the recovery score.

Source-paper comparison for Source Fig. 3 ground-truth recovery error for across/within %sv and d_shared; exact source loss and summary unresolved: Fig. 3 reports estimated versus true across/within %sv and d_shared; closeness to known truth is ordered, but an exact source-defined scalar recovery loss and its units/combination have not been recovered. Do not invent an average over these different endpoints. Source crossvalidated likelihood is an additional ordered fitting/comparison measure with separate normalization still unresolved.
success_criteria: Recover the original Fig. 3 parameter draws/datasets, trial-count grid, dimension search, crossvalidation and final fitting protocol, exact ground-truth metrics and numeric pCCA-FA comparator.
Surpass the source pCCA-FA estimator on the same original recovery task and all original conditions with a justified loss and uncertainty rule; beating only the weaker pCCA control is insufficient.
Preserve %sv and d_shared endpoints separately unless the source supports an exact combined summary; no cherry-picked trial counts, altered generator or favorable seed subset.
A fresh simulation draw set, changed variance ratio/dimensionality, new empirical split or protected pupil prediction is an extension, even if both methods are rerun.
Higher in-sample pupil R², larger covariance components, stronger significance or closer descriptive reconstruction is not an estimator-recovery win.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

paper.title: Interactions across hemispheres in prefrontal cortex reflect global cognitive processing

data.selection: Exactly all 42 *_sort0.2.mat correlation-session files, all three cmp_*.mat array geometries, all three pupil_*.mat session collections, and the corr_sessions README file id 62236873. The other study-specific transformed session files in the 92-file deposit are not extra subjects and are not silently substituted.
data.schema: Spike event times from firstspike+cumulative spiketimesdiff at 30 kHz, spikeinfo channel/sort codes, trialcodes and per-trial angle/timing; pupil behav session-name and trial arrays; array identities and geometry. Pe dat+testDat must be concatenated, not treated as a benchmark train/test split.
data.identity: Native session stem, animal, original dat/testDat trial origin and ordinal, original hardware channel and hemisphere form keys. Exact per-session counts and cross-modal trial bijection must be materialized and frozen. Never join only by array position or infer pupil alignment from equal lengths.
data.coverage: Source inventory must reconcile 42 sessions and 3+3 auxiliary files before any scoring. Pupil exclusion must be listed by native Wa session ID with the paper's IQR calculation and pre/post counts; no identity was guessed from metadata.
data.native_support_status: The complete source inventory is identified by publisher metadata. Scientific MAT payloads, native identities, cross-modal joins and publisher checksums have not been verified by benchmark ingestion. Metadata alone does not establish runnable support.

runtime_storage.compute_note: Original dimension search is up to 15^3×10=33750 fits per session, up to 1,417,500 fold fits over 42 sessions plus final/canonical-correlation fits; channel constraints may reduce this. EM default upper limit 1e6 iterations is a bound, not measured convergence time. Nested protected fits add substantial work; no lightweight claim.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked until the original source simulation artifacts, baseline and endpoint aggregation are recovered. After admission, permit estimator development only on declared source development inputs; keep assessment ground truth and original comparison artifacts evaluator-owned.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze estimation method, hyperparameters, dimension-selection policy, source condition coverage and scoring summary before final comparison on the recovered original Fig. 3 assessment datasets.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare candidate recovery with published and authenticated rerun pCCA-FA on identical original datasets and all source trial-count conditions. Any original Supplementary Fig. 4 likelihood comparison must retain its own exact empirical splits/normalization and be reported separately.
episode.baseline_policy: Source pCCA-FA is the performance comparator; pCCA/FA are source controls. Published results, author reruns and current SOTA remain distinct. Existing covariance/pupil reconstruction is calibration; new protected prediction or newly generated simulations cannot silently replace original paper assessment. Where the original method defines stochastic sampling, a source-supported protocol-equivalent rerun with recorded new random state, calibration tolerance and paired candidate/reference support is admissible; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.
